name: Babelize
description: Lets coding agents make an app global-ready: analyze i18n readiness, extract and wire hardcoded strings to next-intl or react-i18next, translate locale files, and QA translations for missing keys, broken placeholders and invalid ICU, all locally.

BABELIZE_API_KEY.description: Babelize API key for Babelize-hosted translation and the cloud project tools (optional when a BYOK key is set).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your own Anthropic key for babelize_translate (optional).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your own OpenAI key for babelize_translate (optional).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Your own Google Gemini key for babelize_translate (optional).

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Your own Groq key for babelize_translate (optional).

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Your own OpenRouter key for babelize_translate (optional).

BABELIZE_WORKSPACE.description: Folder the local tools may work in (default: client roots, else the working directory).
